title: Price Versus SMA Trend State
rationale: Tests whether a single daily moving-average state can reduce drawdown while retaining enough long-term growth.
tests_claim: A slow price-versus-average trend state improves drawdown-adjusted behavior versus buy-and-hold.
known_limitations: Changing lookback values after failures can become parameter mining.
The template cannot distinguish trend-state failure from slow-response failure by itself.
